target.payload_definition: Total external load carried by bare-arm output flange; no petal head installed in this revision.

flange_frame.note: Prototype flange: source RS00 output face at +25.7 mm from centred 51.4 mm housing, 32 mm journal and 8 mm flange, with separate double-6807 bearing cartridge. Actual contact-face mismatch requires fit coupon and shims before powered assembly.

proposed_motion_screening.status: engineering screening assumption, not confirmed performance

target.reach_note: Current geometry is 550 mm shoulder-to-J7 axial chain plus 65.7 mm prototype flange; do not reinterpret the historical 700 mm shoulder-to-head-task-TCP as a 700 mm bare-flange requirement.
qualification_gates: exact motor interface and purchased hardware fit
printed material and assembled prototype proof test

sampling_note: 1024 unfiltered Halton joint-domain samples +3 presets; not global maxima or collision-qualified workspace.

assumptions: Rigid uniform CAD mass/inertia plus conservative motor envelope tensor.
Rotor reflected inertia overbounds using entire catalogue motor mass at housing radius; mass split remains unknown.
Payload is a 3kg mass bounded within a 50mm radius sphere about its COM.
25deg/s and30deg/s2 each joint are provisional screening conditions.
Bound excludes friction, cable forces, contact loads and thermal capacity.

j7_bearing_radial_screen.note: Radial statics only; excludes prototype journal/cage stiffness, motor-bearing load sharing, axial load, preload and misalignment.

limitations: COM grid is demand, not allowable payload envelope.
Actual rotor inertia, output bearing limits and friction remain unverified.
